charter.office: Office of the Sangguniang Panlungsod, Secretariat
personnelNotes: The charter names the City Secretary and the Vice Mayor, who presides over the Sangguniang Panlungsod and signs the franchises. Everyone else is identified by position: Senior Transportation Officer, Administrative Assistant, Administrative Aide, LLSO IV and Legal Aide.
This charter covers the Secretariat. The Sangguniang Panlungsod itself, the city council, is a separate body.

feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Answer the client feedback form and drop it in the box provided. For inquiries and follow-ups, call 836-9033, 0917-770-3307 or 0999-988-9950.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: Feedback needing an answer is forwarded to the Vice Mayor. The Administrative Officer opens the complaints drop box daily and evaluates each complaint, then forwards it to the Vice Mayor for investigation. The Vice Mayor takes the necessary action and gives feedback to the client.

services.title: Submitting a document to the Sangguniang Panlungsod

services.office: Office of the Sangguniang Panlungsod, Administrative Services Division

steps.client: Submit the document and take your receiving copy with its tracking number.
steps.agency: Receives, reads and checks the documents and any attachments for completeness.

steps.agency: Receives the document by marking the date and time of receipt, the document number and the receiving staff's signature.
steps.personResponsible: Assigned Employee, Office of the Sangguniang Panlungsod

steps.agency: Forwards the document to the Secretary to the Sanggunian for proper disposition or action.
steps.personResponsible: Assigned Employee, Office of the Sangguniang Panlungsod

services.title: Getting a copy of an ordinance or resolution
services.description: Research and copies of the council's records: resolutions, ordinances and appropriation ordinances. A plain photocopy is five pesos a page; a certified true copy is fifty. Records from past years take longer to find than the current year's.
services.office: Office of the Sangguniang Panlungsod, Records and Legislative Tracking Services Division

requirements.item: Identification card: an office ID, school ID or any government-issued ID
requirements.whereToSecure: Your office, school, or a government agency

steps.client: Sign the client logbook.
steps.agency: Gives the logbook to the client.
steps.personResponsible: Assigned employee as Officer of the Day

steps.client: Submit or present the letter request.
steps.agency: Receives the letter request.
Researches the requested data.
steps.processingTime: 2 days for current year resolutions, ordinances or appropriation ordinances; 5 days for past years

steps.client: Pay the required fees at the City Treasurer's Office, showing the order for payment. Make sure you get the official receipt.
steps.agency: Issues the payment order for payment to the City Treasurer's Office.
steps.feeText: PHP 5.00 per photocopied page; PHP 50.00 per page for a certified true copy

steps.agency: Checks the official receipt.

steps.client: Return to the office for the processing and release of the documents.
steps.agency: Presents the photocopied documents to the Sanggunian Secretary or an authorized representative, with the official receipt attached, for signature if you asked for a certified true copy, then releases the document to you.

notes: A record from the current year takes two days to find; anything older takes five.
You only pay the fifty-peso rate if you need the copy certified. A plain photocopy is five pesos a page.
verifyNotes: The charter prints no TOTAL row, so the total shown is summed from the steps alone.

The research step carries both the two-day and the five-day figure in one cell, so the arithmetic counts both and the derived total reads as an upper bound rather than either case. It is left unsplit because the branch is one step inside a single service.
The charter numbers its agency actions 1, 2, 3, 4 and then 3, 4 again, so the pairing of the last two client steps to their actions is an inference.

services.title: Renewing a tricycle or taxicle franchise
services.description: Renewing the permit to operate a tricycle-for-hire or taxicle-for-hire, which a vehicle needs to keep carrying passengers in the city. The application goes to a regular session of the Sangguniang Panlungsod, and the certificate is signed by the Vice Mayor.
services.whoMayAvail: All operators of tricycles-for-hire and taxicles-for-hire renewing their franchise

requirements.item: Mayor's permit for the current year, photocopy
Official receipt and certificate of registration, photocopy
requirements.whereToSecure: Land Transportation Office district or extension offices

requirements.item: Insurance coverage of the unit, photocopy

requirements.whereToSecure: Barangay hall where the client resides, at the secretary's desk

requirements.item: Pictures of the unit, front, back and sides
requirements.whereToSecure: Applicant, or any photo printing shop

steps.client: Submit the required documents at the window.
steps.agency: Receives the required documents for evaluation.
steps.personResponsible: Senior Transportation Officer / Admin. Asst. / Admin. Aide

steps.agency: Inspects the tricycle or taxicle.

steps.client: Receive the letter of undertaking.
steps.agency: Issues the letter of undertaking and the franchising brochure, in lieu of the two-hour seminar conducted every Tuesday.
steps.personResponsible: Senior Transportation Officer / Admin. Asst. / Admin. Aide

steps.agency: Transmits the applications to the Office of the Vice Mayor for inclusion in the regular session of the Sangguniang Panlungsod.
Prepares the certificate of franchise once the approved resolution is received, for the Vice Mayor's signature.

steps.client: Claim the order of payment on presenting the letter of undertaking.
steps.agency: Assesses the fees and issues the order of payment.

steps.client: Pay the fees. Make sure you get the official receipt issued on payment at the City Treasurer's Office.
steps.agency: Releases the certificate of franchise.

notes: The two-hour Tuesday seminar is replaced by a letter of undertaking and a brochure, so you do not have to attend it.
The charter notes that the resolution is received within 20 working days from the date of the session, which is longer than the three days shown against the step.
verifyNotes: The charter prints no TOTAL row, so the total shown is summed from the steps alone.
The charter publishes no fee amount for a franchise renewal, only that fees are assessed and paid at the City Treasurer's Office.

The three-day preparation step carries a parenthetical saying the resolution itself arrives within 20 working days of the session. The derived total counts the three days, not the twenty; the note says so.
